issue.title: aws_savingsplans_savings_plan fails after creating No Upfront plan because upfront_payment_amount changes from null to "0.00000000"
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
`hashicorp/aws v6.42.0`
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

`aws_savingsplans_savings_plan`


### Expected Behavior

If the user creates a no-upfront savings plan, it should successfully apply and produce a consistent result.

### Actual Behavior

Creating a no-upfront savings plan produces an output of "upfront_payment_amount  = 0.00000000" after create, which causes Terraform to treat the resource as tainted.


### Relevant Error/Panic Output

```console

```


### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

```hcl
variable "target_region" {
  type    = string
  default = "us-west-2"
}

data "aws_savingsplans_offerings" "repro" {
  product_type    = "EC2"
  plan_types      = ["EC2Instance"]
  payment_options = ["No Upfront"]
  durations       = [31536000]
  currencies      = ["USD"]

  filter {
    name   = "region"
    values = [var.target_region]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "instanceFamily"
    values = ["g4dn"]
  }
}

resource "aws_savingsplans_savings_plan" "repro" {
  savings_plan_offering_id = one(data.aws_savingsplans_offerings.repro.offerings[*].offering_id)

  # Already padded, so this isolates the upfront_payment_amount issue.
  commitment = "0.92900000"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

```
terraform init
terraform plan
terraform apply
```

### Debug Logging

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand log output</summary>

```console
Provider produced inconsistent result after apply

.upfront_payment_amount: was null, but now cty.StringVal("0.00000000")
```
</details>


### GenAI / LLM Assisted Development

OpenAI Codex

### Important Facts and References

_No response_

### Would you like to implement a fix?

No
